tables.row: one tool setting at one cut-off on the even mock
tables.answers: Which tool is closest to the known answer, and how many false species does each cut-off leave?

columns.method: tool, database size and confidence, e.g. kraken2_16gb_c0.1
columns.threshold_pct: a species counts as present at or above this percent of the profile
columns.fp: species reported that are not in the tube
columns.fn_relaxed: misses if B. spizizenii is counted as B. subtilis
columns.bray_curtis_native_basis: headline distance to truth, 0 best; DNA basis for read tools, cell basis for MetaPhlAn
columns.false_positive_mass_pct: share of the profile on species not in the tube
columns.species_assigned_frac_of_reads: Kraken2 only: fraction of reads that reached species level

tables.answers: How far off is each organism's observed share?

columns.organism: species (rows starting [not in mock] are the largest false calls)
columns.observed_pct: share of that tool's species profile

tables.row: one tool run on one single-organism sample
tables.answers: How many wrong species does a tool invent when only one organism is present?

columns.truth_pct: share of profile that is that organism
columns.other_mass_pct: share of profile that is not the true organism
columns.same_genus_other_pct: wrong share that is in the same genus

tables.row: one tool on the log-distribution mock
tables.answers: Can it quantify the dominant organism and see the rest?

columns.mock_species_detected_ge_0_01pct: tube species seen at 0.01% or more
columns.non_mock_mass_pct: share on species not in the tube

tables.row: one classifier call on the even mock
tables.answers: What does each tool cost in time and memory?

tables.row: one organism added to one spike-in sample
tables.answers: What is the truth for every constructed sample? Truth only, no tool output.

columns.sample: spike_P0 to P3 are panels, spike_H0 is human only
columns.fraction: fraction of the sample's read pairs

tables.row: one organism in one panel for one tool
tables.answers: Was it detected, and how many of the added reads did the tool recover?

columns.species_reads_strict: pairs assigned to that exact species name
columns.detected_ge1: 1 if at least 1 pair supports the species

tables.row: one tool, level and group (bacteria or yeast)
tables.answers: Where does sensitivity fall off as the microbe gets rarer?

columns.n: organisms in the group at that level
columns.detected_ge10: how many were detected with at least 10 pairs

tables.row: one sample, tool and minimum-read threshold
tables.answers: How many wrong species appear, including in the human-only control?

columns.sample: spike sample (spike_H0 has no microbe at all)
columns.min_reads: species must have at least this many read pairs
columns.false_species: species not added and not human
columns.false_species_pathogen_genus: of those, in a genus that contains known pathogens
columns.top3: three largest false species with read pairs

tables.row: one real plasma run at one Kraken2 confidence
tables.answers: What does a real sepsis plasma sample look like to a classifier?

columns.species_ge10: non-human species with at least 10 pairs
columns.reagent_contaminant_genus_share: share of those pairs in genera listed as reagent contaminants (Salter 2014)

tables.row: one top species in one plasma run
tables.answers: What are the biggest non-human calls?

columns.reagent_contaminant_genus: 1 if the genus is a listed reagent contaminant

tables.row: one plasma run scored by two tools
tables.answers: Do Kraken2 and MetaPhlAn name the same species? (Agreement is not correctness.)
